name: Can I replace window weatherstripping myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace window weatherstripping myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some homeowners can perform DIY weatherstripping replacement for simple repairs, hiring a professional ensures proper installation and optimal performance. Professionals have the right tools, experience, and knowledge of various window types and weatherstripping materials to achieve a tight, long-lasting seal. Incorrect installation can lead to continued drafts or even damage to the window frame.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY replacement is possible for simple fixes, but professionals ensure proper installation and a long-lasting, effective seal.
